text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! You struck the weak point 
of every single prey with immaculate 
precision.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That was marvelous technique. 
You carry yourself just like an apex 
predator!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, could you 
teach me your secret later?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I feel like your skills, Trainer, 
could come in very handy while hunting!
